## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Changeset added with `pnpm changeset` (required for any user-facing change to a public package; not needed for docs, CI or tests)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`website/src/content/docs`) when behaviour or the CLI changed
